info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Fares-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Fare Retrieval API provides users with access to fare information for various rideshare rides. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve detailed fare estimates based on ride parameters such as distance, time, and vehicle type. It serves as a valuable resource for applications that need to display pricing information to users or integrate fare calculations into their services. Typical consumers include rideshare platforms, travel applications, and financial tools looking to inform users about potential costs.

get.summary: Retrieve the fare details for a ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the fare information associated with a specific ride. You can use this to understand the pricing structure based on various factors like distance, time, and demand. The response will provide a detailed breakdown of the fare, including base fare, surge pricing, and any additional fees.
